implementation_ci_observation.selected_run_basis: Previously executed exact candidate SHA push and PR runs, independently qualified originally and freshly reverified from immutable proof/log/archive/payload bytes and current GitHub metadata. No newly executed candidate CI run is claimed.
implementation_ci_observation.actual_clean_checkout_package_evidence_b: Actual historical Windows jobs ran the exact candidate tree under the clean-checkout/no-replica fallback requirement. Current desktop candidate ZIP/smokes are separately parent-owned evidence.
implementation_ci_observation.publication_scope: preparation_only; no owner publication consent inferred
implementation_ci_observation.evidence_checkpoint_limit: This record binds the already-tested candidate commit. Any later governance checkpoint needs its own external observation; it cannot self-certify its hash/push/CI.
implementation_ci_observation.case_outcome_scope: Only the actual 67 mandatory automated IDs plus deliberate native controls are qualified here. T074 is the separate parent-owned manual candidate/proposal audit; T067 owner acceptance and T075 publication remain separate.

case_results.reason: Manual release-candidate proposal binds the reviewed revision, exact freshly built and smoke-tested ZIP and all required evidence; no new owner consent or automated T074 test is inferred.

sync_observation.note: The containing evidence checkpoint is observed externally after commit/push.

limitations: Preparation only: merge/tag/public release/website deployment remain unapproved and unexecuted; T075 is pending.
T074 remains a manual owner-kind proposal/audit gate; 67 mandatory automated case IDs and 27 suites are unchanged.
Historical T001-T004 characterization, deliberate failure T007 and direct T067 owner acceptance keep their distinct meanings.
Owner acceptance remains 5a32fc6533c6f9fae1d36c271b515d1d1dd4d8ad; unchanged algorithm/BAT and version/header-only subsequent application changes do not supply new candidate consent.
Windows 11 actual ordinary-account desktop automation and Windows Server 2025 CI are separate. Windows 10 remains untested; live UNC/network-share support is owner-excluded D35.

Candidate media smoke uses approved synthetic media and owned OutputParent, not a physical drag/real Pictures or subjective quality claim. Matching BAT setup failure verifies native propagation, not completed-media BAT usage.
ZIP reproducibility is measured per host and decoded content across hosts; a checksum is not a signature. Publication must verify the actual named tag, asset and public download.

No website repository/provider context exists. Published metadata/download fields remain null/unavailable and original poster remains held; deployment and public reuse of private owner media are not authorized.
A draft scratch consistency helper was preserved untested/unshipped; no tracked guard, suite or coverage change resulted.

build_provenance.reproducibility: Exact Git content, ordinal entries, fixed ZIP time/attributes and the NoCompression setting. ZIP framing varies by runtime. Byte equality must be verified for the actual build hosts; no universal ZIP-writer guarantee.

limitations: Unreleased unsigned local candidate; no merge/tag/release/deployment or publication consent.
Windows 11 ordinary-user synthetic smoke only; Windows 10 and live UNC not tested.
PS1 media uses owned OutputParent seam and actual pinned ImageMagick; real Pictures not normalized.
Matching BAT with closed stdin exercises invalid-source setup/native exit only; no completed media, physical gesture or pause interaction claim.
Video is synthetic opaque bytes with .mp4 suffix; byte copying is checked, not video decoding.
Fixture RGB/alpha metadata checks are bounded synthetic coverage; no universal codec/delegate/policy sandbox or all-metadata/privacy guarantee.
ZIP equality is measured per actual host; framing differences are recorded separately.
Raw paths/context/logs remain ignored and local; sanitized evidence must be independently derived.

requirements.review_observation: The whole namespace reserves mirrored directories/generated names/unique legacy names case-insensitively before deterministic ordinal collision suffix allocation. No-replacement File.Move protects the final transition even after the availability check. Planner cases include secondary and case-only controls; native arrival controls verify preserved external file/directory bytes.
requirements.qualification: Real native positives are separated from controlled negative seams.

requirements.review_observation: Canonical segment containment, reparse ancestors and 128-bit directory identities reject nested/aliased output before the destination probe. Exclusive GUID run directories cannot adopt an existing directory; source lookalike generated work/report names get a free namespace. Real concurrent child launches and native long-path directory controls substantiate isolation.
requirements.qualification: Live UNC/network-share validation is owner-excluded D35. Lexical roots and local identity controls do not certify a remote provider.

requirements.review_observation: Each attempt uses a fresh exclusive owned directory and CreateNew reservation; acceptable exit, nonempty regular JPEG, positive dimensions, exactly one frame and full +ping decode precede same-volume no-overwrite move. Videos use regular partials, read-share streams and size/modification checks. Cleanup uses explicit owned paths and preserves unknown siblings. Real decoded JPEG and copied-video hashes plus controlled truncated/stale/conflict/partial negatives exercise the actual orchestration.
requirements.qualification: Real native positives are separated from controlled negative seams.

requirements.review_observation: Decoder-visible sequence counts are validated, the selected first image/frame is explicit, GIF/WebP first canvas is coalesced, TIFF first page is oriented and omissions are logged. Native pixel/dimension oracles distinguish the selected canvas/page from a differently colored second item, including actual HEVC collection reads.
requirements.qualification: Decoder-visible counts do not reveal hidden container items; no retained animation or universal decoder/build guarantee.

requirements.review_observation: Profile inspection/extraction validates structure/model while preserving the snapshot ICC; relative-intent sRGB transform precedes HDRI clamp, encoded-sRGB white alpha composition and stripping. Untagged CMYK/unsupported space and unsafe profile diagnostics fail. Independent profile-aware patch references, pre-JPEG and JPEG tolerances, malformed-profile bytes, real orientation/metadata probes and alpha pixel controls support the stated policy.
requirements.qualification: Profiles supplying only perceptual mapping may use the delegate fallback. Not arbitrary ICC certification or subjective owner color approval.

requirements.review_observation: The key combines lowercase filename, immutable live LastWriteTimeUtc ticks and equal length. Only finalized successful source snapshots register. Failed-first/finalization conflicts cannot poison later candidates; skips retain explicit source/output/status links. Tests deliberately demonstrate that equal-key/equal-length different bytes can still match.
requirements.qualification: This retained lightweight heuristic is accepted behavior, not content equality or preservation of every source in the derivative tree.

requirements.review_observation: Literal PowerShell filesystem operations and neutral snapshot names prevent selectors/templates on user filenames; C# quotes native arguments correctly, controlled paths alone receive extended prefixes. BAT delayed expansion is disabled and trailing folder/root separators are protected. Native deceptive neighboring-image pixel checks, real Windows argv and long-path controls cover literal identity.
requirements.qualification: CMD can expand variable expressions before the BAT receives them; physical Explorer drag events and every filesystem/long-path configuration are not inferred.

requirements.review_observation: The positional adapter rejects zero/extra arguments; positive integer Int64 caps are validated without narrowing. Dependency lookup uses Application .exe only; actual exit/diagnostics/version/format queries gate setup. Missing decoder entries become per-file errors while supported siblings continue; missing required JPEG writer fails setup. Destination probe/decimal space estimate precede the run root.
requirements.qualification: ImageMagick remains required for video-only input; space estimates are best effort and unavailable measurements warn.

requirements.review_observation: Invariant decimal bytes plus B reach jpeg:extent; measured Int64 JPEG length decides compliance. The original six 100/90/80/70/60/50 scales, 4:2:0 sampling and progressive output remain. Only valid above-target candidates advance; the valid final 50-percent candidate is an explicit warning/code2. Failed later attempts never revive earlier output.
requirements.qualification: Best-effort lossy derivatives remain; no hard byte-cap or cross-codec identical JPEG promise. Large Int64 extent may round inside the encoder.

requirements.review_observation: Independent bounded stdout/stderr readers and native result fields separate exit, start error, timeout and incomplete drainage. A single anchored zero-exit benign JPEG warning is tolerated only with full candidate validation; unknown/profile/decode diagnostics fail. Only diagnosed sharing/lock failures retry twice per item with fresh candidates and unchanged color/alpha policy. Actual newline-free multi-MiB pipe tests and native warning/error controls substantiate handling.
requirements.qualification: Real native positives are separated from controlled negative seams.

requirements.review_observation: Traversal records unreadable subtrees and uninspectable entries, skips reparse entries and continues accessible siblings. Log failure disables the broken disk sink once, emits a bounded fallback and degrades the run; timestamp setters attempt both fields separately and retain validated files. Tests use actual owned denied ACLs/junctions/locked log and explicitly controlled setter/sink failures.
requirements.qualification: ACL fixtures are disposable owned trees; no permissions are relaxed to read a user source. Unknown subtree file counts are not invented.

requirements.review_observation: Native creation atomically assigns a private non-breakaway job before execution, whitelists inherited handles and kills only that job on timeout/return. One per-image stopwatch spans phases; child-only resource/cache settings preserve installed policy. Cooperative cancellation polls between work, preserves admitted completed moves, cleans owned partials and returns interrupted130. Native three-process identity/pipe/locked-handle, unrelated real ImageMagick, stricter private policy and forced worker tests are substantive.
requirements.qualification: Controlled Request/phase pacing is distinguished from the historical actual private-console CTRL_C_EVENT observations. Synchronous filesystem I/O can delay interruption; absent/closed/stopped/force-killed hosts can bypass report/cleanup/130. Cache ceilings are not total delegate heap limits or a hostile-media sandbox; native magic detection is not a decoder-module allowlist.

requirements.review_observation: Terminal media outcome is committed before ancillary operations; discovered file outcomes form one reconciled partition, with warning attributes separate. Signed savings use paired finalized image bytes only, video bytes separate. CSV text has an inert reversible text prefix plus control/backslash escaping; numeric fields are invariant generated values. Negative savings, real Import-Csv round trips, foreign report arrival, report failures and cancellation after video move are asserted.
requirements.qualification: PowerShell Import-Csv tests do not certify Excel edit/save/reopen behavior. Absolute/native diagnostics remain local; current report is not a complete inventory if scanning or reporting is degraded.

requirements.review_observation: BAT clears inherited ERRORLEVEL, rejects empty/extra folders, retains NoProfile/process-only Bypass, saves native status immediately and returns it after honest message/pause. Native private-console tests independently observe real pause after the child exits and check0/1/2/130/unexpected37/host9009, character argv and persistent user/security context. Full safe Command drivers exercise real partial/cancel/run-level behavior.
requirements.qualification: The byte-identical production BAT is paired with an owned safe driver/output parent; this is not a new physical desktop drag-and-drop or real Pictures known-folder run.

cross_cutting_invariants_reviewed: Existing two-file positional interface and default1MiB retained; test seams do not add user options or dependencies.

No source write/delete/metadata stripping occurs; source snapshots read with sharing that blocks cooperative writers. Existing synthetic hashes plus creation/modified timestamps substantiate tool preservation; access-time effects are excluded.
JPEG white alpha/sRGB/metadata policy and stable video byte copies remain explicit; unsupported files remain untouched.

No source/destination cleanup glob, no overwrite fallback, no global policy weakening, auto-install, uploader/account/telemetry, user-input shell evaluation or parallel item worker pool was introduced.
Only version/usage/log header changed in runtime since owner-accepted5a32fc; no BAT or image-normalization algorithm diff in that interval.
